title: Make drain count only outcome-changing landings and check all page text
summary: Fix `athena drain` so "target met" needs (1) a landing whose diff touches what the explainer is built from, and (2) a model-backed check of every page text input (claims.json, intro.json intro/transition/glossary, any other text file) against the pinned source, failing on contradicted or omitted statements. Audience: the person running drain who trusts "target met". The retry starts from base, so it redoes both rules and covers the intro text the last attempt missed.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria inject a wrong statement into each page text input and assert drain does not stop as target met.
Tests added for drain rules and the source check; fmt, clippy and test must pass.
The check covers every text-bearing page input, not only claims.json.
A code check fails if a text-bearing page file is not covered by the source check.
Add a decision in docs/decisions.md with alternatives and a CHANGELOG entry.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The base has no source-vs-text check and no outcome-changing-landing rule; RealSteps::check_page in drain.rs only tests model.json for self-consistency (read).

Page text lives in studies/<name>/claims.json and intro.json (intro, transition, glossary); other studies/*.json files are structural or evidence, and the producer must enumerate which are text-bearing.
Landings count only if their changed paths include studies/, the site generator, or the page sources.
The model-backed check is guarded by the budget and its cost is added to spent_usd; the reserve must scale with the number of studies checked, or all studies be checked in one capped call.
The source-check agent is recorded under a role that matches its verifier model and cap, not Role::Audience.
Existing self-consistency check stays as a floor.
The real source-check path is tested end to end with a fake agent and a stub pinner.

acceptance_criteria.text: With a stubbed Steps, a drain whose only landing changed paths outside studies/, the site generator and the page sources, with the rating at the target, does not stop as "target met". The report says the landing did not change the outcome. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.
A landing that changes a study file or the site generator, then a rating at the target and a passing source check, still stops as "target met". Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.

Tests inject one wrong statement into each of claims.json, the intro, the transition and a glossary entry (for example teardown closes instead of can reopen; yolo-on allows self-merge; wrong handoff frees a place), plus one omitted fact. With a fake agent and stub pinner, RealSteps::check_page fails each time and names the statement, and drain does not report "target met". Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
A code check and test fail if any text-bearing file in a study directory is not covered by the source check. A page with correct text in every file passes. Run `cargo test`.

The source check is budget-guarded: the reserve covers every model call it will make (one per study or a single call), drain stops as "budget spent" when it does not fit, and the cost is added to spent_usd. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.

Stop::TargetMet docs, module docs, `athena drain --help`, a new decision in docs/decisions.md (with alternatives, covering all page text, and the self-consistency floor) and CHANGELOG.md state both rules.

out_of_scope: Rewriting the studies' content or fixing the wrong facts in the existing page
Changing the audience rating rubric or target value
Running the check against the live model as part of tests
departures: Larger than the reference: two rules plus a model-backed check over several page files, with fake-agent tests, and the last attempt failed on scope.
